test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,
 
'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B',
 
'A - B' means 'A is the father of B',
 
'A × B' means 'A is the brother of B' and
 
'A & B' means 'A is the son of B'.
 
How is T related to G if T + Q - R × H & G?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44b1d977930a5ae8ff2ad87e3b6407517b08dce70e8f045c243365162391bc53.png] 

**Given:**

'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the father of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the brother of B' and

'A & B' means 'A is the son of B'.

T + Q - R × H & G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb46bdb3383b08647901f5b704a18dddd9dabf452e11e95b829b8e60501fca5a.png] 

Clearly, 'T' is Husband sister of 'G'.

Hence, the correct answer is 'Husband sister'..
